Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
Situation:

Methuselah A uses temptation with the appropriate number
of counters to take control of Frederick the Weak from
methusealh B.
During that same turn Methuselah A is ousted due
to damage from Dragonbound (during discard phase).

Is Frederick the Weak:
A:burned
B:returned to original controller (Meth B)

Thanks,

-John P.
Winnipeg

Messages.Author: jeff...@pacbell.net
Messages.Body:


A:burned. All cards controlled by a Methuselah are instantly burned
when said Meth is ousted.

Jeff

Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:


No he doesn´t keep them. At the end of the turn the control switches
back to the original owner and since he is ousted the minions burn.
